title: Ukrainian Cheese Skewers
description: A simple and delicious Ukrainian-inspired appetizer or snack made with cheese and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Ukrainian cheese
ingredients.notes: such as farmer's cheese or a similar type

ingredients.name: crunchy vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Thread the Ukrainian cheese and crunchy vegetables onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes, turning occasionally, until the cheese is melted and the vegetables are tender.
